name: When Premium Carpet Is Worth It — and When It Isn't
title-tag: Is High-End Carpet Worth It? Honest Math | Medina WA
meta-description: Premium carpet is worth it when the money buys density, twist and fiber — not softness trademarks. The per-year-of-life math, and where to save instead.
post-summary: April 8, 2027 · Premium carpet pays when the money buys engineering — fiber, density, twist, a texture warranty with substance — and the room has the traffic and time horizon to collect. It is wasted on softness trademarks, short ownership and guest rooms. How to read the back of the sample, and the honest per-year-of-life math.
